title: Silver Rewards Card: Which Travel Purchases Qualify for 4% Cash Back?
summary: Explains which transactions qualify for 4.0% cash back on the Silver Rewards Card when they post under a “travel” category, including airlines, hotels, car rentals/car-sharing, passenger rail, ferries, long-distance buses, select OTAs/tour operators (as merchant of record), and rideshares/taxis coded as travel. Also lists common ineligible categories (onboard retail/food, vacation rentals/home-sharing, parking/tolls/local transit when not classified as travel, and cases where third-party processors mask the travel category) and advises reviewing posted statements and contacting support with receipts for category review.
faqs: Which types of travel purchases earn the Silver Rewards Card 4% cash back?
Do rideshare and taxis qualify for the travel 4% rate?
